blocks.text: KARMA proves an A I agent's reputation on Stellar, without ever revealing the score.
A Groth16 proof, verified on-chain by Stellar's native BN254 host functions. No trusted server. No leaked business data.
We audited our own circuit and found two real soundness gaps. The score wasn't bound to the commitment, and the Merkle root wasn't pinned on-chain. Both are fixed, in this live deployment.
Now watch the whole thing happen, in one HTTP request.
The agent signs a real USDC payment, and attaches its zero-knowledge proof. One request. The provider settles the payment on-chain, and verifies the proof on-chain, before it ever runs the skill.
Two live Stellar transactions. One settles real USDC. One verifies a real proof. From a single HTTP call.
Trustless skill invocation for AI agents. Live on Stellar Testnet, today.
